text:
Jesper Bratt is on a six-game point streak (two goals, six assists), and the Devils are dominating with him on the ice: 64% of the expected goals at five on five, nine points better than without him. The Hockey News noted Sheldon Keefe turning to the Bratt, Jack Hughes and Arseny Gritsyuk line to flip momentum, which tells you where he sits in the coach's trust.

The goals are light (four on 5.3 expected), but the assists keep coming, and that's his game. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him among the best setup men in the league (94th percentile in primary shot assists) and breaking out with possession 72% of the time. Evolving-Hockey had him in the 98th percentile for driving offense, and better than his goals said.

A sixth-round pick from 2016, he's played every one of his 653 games in New Jersey. Our range has him at 61 to 85 points.
